concerns.text: The plan cites the **verified NIST CSV** dataset at `https://huggingface.co/datasets/leeroy-jankins/NIST-AI-Risk-Management-Framework/resolve/main/NIST%20AI%20Risk%20Management%20Framework.csv`. This dataset contains AI risk‑management framework records, not polymer degradation data (no SMILES, no degradation pathway labels, no environmental variables). Using it violates FR‑001/FR‑008 which require a dataset of polymer degradation records. The cited source is therefore the wrong dataset for the research question.
